subject.title: feat(ui): session diff panel showing a session checkout's changes in chat

question: Should OpenClaw accept a permanent core `sessions.diff` protocol method and Control UI review surface once its Git execution boundary is hardened?
rationale: This PR introduces a new core Gateway API and user-facing review mode, while the protected `maintainer` label reserves final product ownership for a human even after the mechanical security defect is fixed.

options.title: Accept after hardening
options.body: Keep the feature direction and require the fsmonitor fix, conflict resolution, and real checkout proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the core feature
options.body: Keep the linked issue open while maintainers choose a different review integration or API boundary.
